note: Proposed MCP tool contract (not yet served). Each tool is a thin adapter over `observstory query` and reads the same snapshot.json the dashboard renders. No tool calls GitHub itself.

tools.name: observstory.changes_since
tools.description: Work items, default-branch commits and signals that changed after a timestamp. Use at the start of a run with the time of your previous run.

tools.name: observstory.work_near
tools.description: In-flight work touching the given paths or areas, with overlap signals and evidence. Call before starting a task, passing the files you plan to change.

tools.name: observstory.overlaps
tools.description: Overlap signals, optionally limited to a path prefix.

tools.name: observstory.open_loops
tools.description: Stale work, branches without PRs, PRs waiting on other PRs, open PRs with no reviewer.

tools.name: observstory.handoff
tools.description: Open PRs grouped by the author's declared review state (review requested / no reviewer / draft).

guarantees: Every response carries as_of (snapshot time) so the agent knows how fresh it is.
Every signal carries basis (derived|heuristic|declared), confidence and evidence URLs.
Signals are about areas and work items. There is no tool that returns per-person activity.
